youtube_description:
We recently got the chance to sit down with a few of the voice actors from the latest edition to the FINAL FANTASY franchise, FINAL FANTASY XVI.

In this interview, Ben Starr speaks about what it's like to voice the protagonist of the new game.

Pick up a copy of FINAL FANTASY XVI here: https://bit.ly/3NJAdLx
